question: A sum of ₹2,500 is invested in a bank at 2% interest per annum compounded annually. On maturity, the amount payable becomes ₹2,601. Find the time period of the investment.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Amount to Principal = 2601 / 2500

Rate (R) = 2% = 2/100 = 1/50

Multiplying factor for 1 year = (1 + 1/50) = 51/50

Since (51/50)² = 2601/2500, the exponent equals the time period.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Amount (A) = ₹2601

Rate of Interest (R) = 2% per annum

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T
